title: Amhara Kitfo Special
community: Amhara highlands — the highland version of raw beef
author: Mama Tigist
desc: Amhara Kitfo — finely minced highland beef warmed in kibbeh with more mitmita than the standard recipe. The Amhara highland version of kitfo uses more mitmita and less berbere, reflecting the regional spice preference for the fierce heat of bird's eye chilli over the complex heat of berbere.
longDesc: Amhara kitfo is hotter than Gurage kitfo — the highland preference for mitmita over berbere produces a fiercer, more immediate heat. Served with the finest Amhara ayib and gomen.
ingredients: 600g freshest possible beef mince — hand-chopped preferred
steps: Add beef mince. Toss to warm — maximum 2 minutes.
chefTips: Amhara version: more mitmita than berbere.
healthBenefits: Very high bioavailable protein and iron.
culturalNote: Amhara kitfo is the highland celebration of raw beef — fiercer than the Gurage version, reflecting the Amhara palate's love for mitmita heat.
